subject.title: [Feature]: Audit log for agent memory changes

question: What memory mutation audit contract should OpenClaw support for MEMORY.md and memory/*.md writes before implementation starts?
rationale: The remaining work defines trust, privacy, cause propagation, storage location, and tamper-evidence boundaries; source inspection shows the gap, but automation cannot choose those product/security semantics safely.

options.title: Design first-class mutation audit contract
options.body: Specify operation types, cause/session/user propagation, content-summary or hash policy, storage owner, integrity verification, and public docs before accepting an implementation.

options.title: Route to external plugin or MCP only
options.body: Treat Pinchy, world-model-mcp, or a ClawHub package as the supported path and close core work only after maintainers decide OpenClaw should not own memory-file mutation auditing.

options.title: Use open Memory Audit PR as input
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/87900 as prior implementation material, but keep this issue open until a merged design covers all-write mutation audit and security proof.

recommendation.title: Design first-class mutation audit contract
recommendation.body: Specify operation types, cause/session/user propagation, content-summary or hash policy, storage owner, integrity verification, and public docs before accepting an implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already carried the prior issue review and has recent adjacent memory/security routing history, making this the strongest available decision-owner signal.
